shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertical stone surface
horizontal registers or bands separating scenes
repeated row of similar figures/motifs along a band
quadruped in profile at the lower part
justification: Both are low reliefs organised into stacked horizontal registers with profile creatures and figures, and both include a band of repeated near-identical motifs, but this is a very generic scheme. A shows schematic zoomorphic beings (bird-like/reptilian heads, a crouching figure, a long-necked quadruped) with no clothing, weapons or setting, whereas B shows naturalistic clothed human attendants with detailed coiffures and beards carrying implements beside a horse's head, above a band of rosettes — conventions of proportion, detail and subject that do not match.
